name: Form of the Faerie Dragon, Mythic
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 7, druid 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a faerie dragon scale)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw see below; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You assume the form of a Tiny faerie dragon. You gain +6 size bonus to Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus, fly 60 feet (perfect), darkvision 60 feet, low-light vision, and an euphoria breath weapon in a 5 ft. cone (Fort save negates).

You also gain one bite attack (1d3). You can only use the breath weapon twice per casting of this spell, and you must wait 1d4 rounds between uses. Creatures that fail their save are staggered, sickened, and immune to fear effects for 1d6 rounds.
